mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the deeper tissue and surface was worthwhile because the result showed how the protective and living layers fit together, building on the explanation that supplies come from underneath.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sweat gland was a little repetitive: the result confirmed the fitting but added no detail.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer skin layer has no blood vessels and its living cells get supplies from below.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The outlined slots explained why the gland and nerve endings belonged in the skin, though the fittings themselves were straightforward.

continue.text: I would probably continue: connecting the finished skin to the body brought its different jobs together, although some of the fittings were predictable.
